verdicts.reason: A stacks pool image, house and headline top to bottom and fills the tall format sensibly. However, the 'Mile Construction' headline sits cramped against the bottom and right edges, the top-left beige block has an odd notch cut out of its corner, and the second beige strip butts awkwardly against the house photo. B shrinks the pool image to a small, trivial fragment cropped at the top edge, and the beige block keeps the same odd notch. B's headline also nearly touches the right edge, and it leaves a large dead white area at the bottom with a stray beige block floating in the corner, so the composition is unbalanced.
